name: PdxFormActions
description:
The submit and reset button bar of a form, wired to the form it sits in, with configurable
labels, alignment and a loading state.

members.name: submitLabel
members.description: Submit button label. Uses i18n registry default if not set.

members.name: resetLabel
members.description: Reset button label. Set to 'none' to hide. Uses i18n registry default if not set.

members.name: showLoading
members.description: Show loading spinner on submit button while submitting.

members.name: align
members.description: Where the buttons sit: end (the default), start, center, or apart.
